project.name: Komit-V2
project.description: Productized Service & SaaS platform for university IT group projects with scheduled GitHub auto-commits via authentic student accounts.

nodes.name: PRD.md
nodes.summary: Product Requirements Document: Joki proyek kuliah, pricing formula, 3 core database tables, user flows.

nodes.name: DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Auros design system: Liquid Abyss #012624 canvas, Liquid Kelp #003734 raised cards, Aurora gradient CTA, Matter 500 typography, 3D bioluminescent particle sphere data orb.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Engineering & design rules, execution chain, and lazy senior coding discipline.

nodes.name: projects
nodes.summary: Projects table storing order data, pricing, AI ideas, repo URL, README and PPT status.

nodes.name: project_members
nodes.summary: Project members table with student details and server-only GitHub OAuth access tokens.

nodes.name: commit_schedules
nodes.summary: Commit schedule queue for weekly automated git pushes on behalf of group members.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Core domain TypeScript models: Project, ProjectMember, CommitSchedule, IdeaItem.

nodes.name: supabase.ts
nodes.summary: Supabase client and service role admin client configuration with configuration guards.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Unified data access layer bridging Supabase PostgreSQL and local in-memory mock storage.

nodes.name: /api/projects
nodes.summary: API route for listing projects and submitting new orders with price calculation.

nodes.name: /api/ai/ideas
nodes.summary: Generates 3 project recommendations with unique lecturer-targeted gimmicks for UAS.

nodes.name: /api/ai/readme
nodes.summary: Generates formatted README presentation materials and Q&A prep for lecturer exams.

nodes.name: /api/auth/github
nodes.summary: Initiates GitHub OAuth authorization flow with member state and repo/workflow scopes.

nodes.name: /api/auth/github/callback
nodes.summary: Exchanges GitHub OAuth code, retrieves user identity, and secures token in database.

nodes.name: /api/admin/commit/push
nodes.summary: Pushes commits directly to GitHub repository using student member's OAuth token.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing page in Persuade mode: constellation canvas visualizer, value proposition, pricing.

nodes.name: order/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Operate mode order page: service and package selection, member count slider, QRIS checkout.

nodes.name: setup/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Project setup: payment gate, AI ideation & gimmick selection, member form, invite link.

nodes.name: project/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Client dashboard: commit schedule timeline, member OAuth status, README and PPT add-on.

nodes.name: join/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Contributor onboarding page: group member selection and GitHub OAuth connection.

nodes.name: admin/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Operator panel: QRIS verification, commit scheduler & live push trigger, PPT upload.

nodes.name: HeroConstellation.tsx
nodes.summary: Interactive constellation particle canvas visualization of collaborative git commits.

nodes.name: Navbar.tsx
nodes.summary: Site-wide navigation bar featuring logo lockup, ghost links, and Electric Iris CTA pill.

nodes.name: Footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimalist footer adhering to void canvas rules and hairline subtle dividers.

tour.title: Dokumen Spesifikasi & Rantai Aturan
tour.description: Pelajari aturan engineering di AGENTS.md, kebutuhan bisnis di PRD.md, dan sistem visual Dala di DESIGN.md.

tour.title: Skema Inti Database (Supabase)
tour.description: 3 tabel utama: projects (data order & ide), project_members (token OAuth terisolasi), dan commit_schedules (antrean push).

tour.title: Data Layer & Layanan Terpadu
tour.description: src/lib/data.ts menjembatani Supabase PostgreSQL dengan in-memory fallback agar aplikasi tahan uji di lingkungan dev.

tour.title: Alur Pemesanan & QRIS (/order)
tour.description: Kalkulasi dinamis formula harga N x Rp 50.000, paket layanan, dan upload bukti transfer QRIS.

tour.title: Setup Proyek, Ide AI & Gimmick Dosen
tour.description: Generator 3 ide AI dengan gimmick pemikat dosen dan formulir data mahasiswa anggota kelompok.

tour.title: Koneksi GitHub OAuth Anggota (/join/[id])
tour.description: Anggota kelompok menghubungkan akun GitHub asli mereka secara aman untuk persiapan cicil commit.

tour.title: Client Dashboard & Bahan UAS
tour.description: Pemantauan progress commit mingguan per anggota, generate README gratis, atau pesan slide PPT jadi.

tour.title: Admin & Tim Joki Panel (/admin)
tour.description: Verifikasi bukti QRIS, atur jadwal commit, eksekusi push via GitHub Contents API, dan unggah file PPT.
